Requirements You have two cards in your hand of the same suit.

Your tracing along fate’s lines have brought two similar stories together. You Play two cards of the same suit; its effects are dependent on the suit of the cards Played:

  • Strength/Dexterity: You make a Strike at a creature you can reach or within range. You roll the attack roll twice and take the better result; this is a Fortune effect.

  • Intelligence/Charisma: You can Cast a Spell which has a cast time of up to 3 actions, adding the number of actions necessary to complete the spell. This action contributes 1 action to the spell. If it requires a saving throw, one target must roll their saving throw twice and take the worse result; this is a Misfortune effect. If it requires an attack roll, you roll your attack roll twice and take the higher result; this is a Fortune effect.

  • Constitution/Wisdom: Your next Foreteller spell within 1 minute does not cost a focus point.
